basics.title: Data Engineer
basics.summary: Data Engineer specialized in Big Data, reliable data pipelines, and scalable architectures for analytics, BI, and AI/ML use cases.

bullets: Designed and maintained ETL/ELT pipelines with Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and PySpark to support analytics and AI/ML use cases.
Contributed to a Medallion architecture that structured enterprise data flows and improved data accessibility for BI, forecasting, and AI applications.
Built data models, transformation layers, and curated datasets used for analytics, feature preparation, and machine learning workflows.
Developed web scraping and ingestion pipelines to collect, clean, and integrate external data sources.
Used Apache Airflow to orchestrate and monitor scheduled data workflows.
Worked with AWS S3 and Data Lake components to support scalable data storage and processing.
Automated dbt testing and deployment workflows with GitHub Actions and CI/CD practices to improve reliability and maintainability.
Collaborated with Data, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable pipelines and improve the data platform.
Designed and improved ETL/ELT pipelines with Apache Airflow and Python to ingest and transform data from APIs, Data Lakes, and cloud storage into analytics-ready datasets.
Improved DAG reliability and maintainability while working with AWS services including EC2, S3, and Amazon MWAA.
Contributed to GitLab CI/CD automation and data quality checks to support more reliable deployments.
Worked with business, product, and engineering teams to turn data needs into reusable datasets, documentation, and self-service reporting assets.
Contributed to a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflow used to generate tailored reports from legal and domain-specific knowledge bases.
Used Apache Spark, Hadoop, and GCP services to prepare and process large datasets for AI and reporting workflows.
Built data extraction, chunking, and indexing workflows in MongoDB to support semantic search and contextual retrieval.
Worked on prompt design and retrieval logic to improve response relevance and output quality.
Supported data preparation and iterative delivery of AI reporting features within an agile workflow.
